zh: 牲畜过秤与动态读数
牲畜会在秤台上走动。选型时先确定单头或成群称重、最大总重量、围栏尺寸和进出方向，再讨论仪表怎样判定读数稳定。日常清洗方式也会影响台面、防滑处理和传感器防护的选择。
en: Weighing live animals

Animals move while on the platform. Define whether each weighing cycle covers one animal or a group, then record the maximum combined weight, pen dimensions and gate direction. Discuss how the indicator accepts a stable reading and how the cleaning routine affects deck finish and load cell protection.

zh: 料塔重量如何反映库存
称重模块测得塔体与物料的合计重量。建立空塔基准后，可用重量变化记录进料和消耗。支腿数量、偏载、风载及进出料管道对塔体的约束，都是设计支承与校验方案时需要说明的条件。
en: Measuring feed bin inventory

Weigh modules carry the bin and its contents. An empty-bin reference allows operators to track deliveries and consumption by weight. Specify the number of legs, uneven loading, wind exposure and pipe connections when planning the supports and calibration access.

zh: 屠宰线轨道称重
悬挂物经过称重轨段时，其重量通过吊具传递给称重装置。采购时应提供轨型、吊具自重、吊挂间距、线速和清洗条件，以便判断轨段长度、去皮方式及数据采集时机。
en: Weighing on an overhead rail

A suspended load transfers its weight through the hanger to the weighing rail. Provide the rail profile, hanger tare, hanger spacing, line speed and washdown requirements so the supplier can assess the section length, tare procedure and point of capture.

zh: 从领卡到生成磅单
先确定卡片绑定的是车辆、订单还是运输任务。系统需要把首次重量和复称重量关联到同一笔业务，并记录物料和时间。空车先过磅或重车先进场都会影响操作顺序，流程图应体现实际运输方向。
en: From card issue to weigh ticket

Decide whether the card identifies a vehicle, an order or a single trip. Both weight records must belong to the same transaction, with a material reference and timestamps. Map inbound deliveries and outbound collections separately because an empty truck and a loaded truck start different sequences.

zh: 装料目标与地磅复核
装车前要明确目标净重、车辆皮重来源和允许偏差。装料端的目标值与出场地磅的实测值应分别保存。遇到超差时，约定车辆返回补料、卸料或人工复核的路径。
en: Loading targets and check weighing

Define the target net load, the source of vehicle tare and the accepted tolerance. Keep the loading target separate from the outbound measured weight. Agree where a truck goes for a top-up, partial unloading or operator review when the difference exceeds the agreed limit.

zh: 交付前走一遍异常流程
用同一辆车测试换卡、重复刷卡、订单取消和网络中断恢复，确认每个装车任务只生成一张有效磅单。询价时附上车道布置、现用磅单样式及订单系统所需的数据字段。
en: Test exceptions before acceptance

Walk one vehicle through card replacement, repeated scans, order cancellation and network recovery. Verify that each completed trip produces one valid ticket. Include the lane layout, current ticket format and required order-system fields in the project brief.

zh: 一次完整的无人过磅
车辆识别后，系统需确认车辆完整停在秤台上，并在仪表重量稳定时记录读数。毛重与皮重归入同一运输任务后可计算净重。入口到出口的车道方向决定识别设备、显示屏和司机提示的位置。
en: A complete unattended weighing cycle

After vehicle identification, confirm that the entire vehicle is on the deck and capture a stable indicator reading. Match gross and tare to the same trip to calculate net weight. Lane direction determines where identification devices, displays and driver prompts belong.

zh: 哪些情况交给值班人员
车牌识别失败、两车紧跟、重量无法稳定或缺少对应皮重，都需要明确处理人和待车位置。设计阶段可列出每一种异常的屏幕提示、人工放行条件及操作记录，方便现场追溯。
en: When the operator takes over

Unreadable plates, tailgating, an unstable weight and a missing tare each need a designated operator and holding point. Define the driver prompt, conditions for manual release and the event record for each exception.

zh: 用高峰车流校验布局
记录高峰小时进出车辆数、最长车长、排队空间和空重车行驶方向。再根据车辆停车、识别、称重和驶离所需时间，判断是否需要分向车道或独立复核位。
en: Size the lane for peak traffic

Record peak arrivals and departures, maximum vehicle length, queue space and the direction of empty and loaded traffic. Allow time for stopping, identification, weight capture and departure when comparing shared lanes, directional lanes and a separate review bay.

zh: 先画出设备与车辆的相对位置
在现场平面图上标出秤台前后缘、道闸、车辆检测点、识别设备和司机停车线。检查最长车辆完整上秤后司机能否看清提示，并确认进出车辆不会抢占同一段引道。
en: Lay out devices against the vehicle path

Mark the deck ends, barriers, vehicle detection points, identification equipment and stop lines on the site plan. Check that a driver can see instructions when the longest vehicle is fully on the deck and that opposing vehicles can use the approaches as planned.

zh: 把放行条件写成可测试的步骤
明确车辆到位、身份确认、重量稳定、数据保存和出口放行的先后顺序。分别说明道闸、信号灯与显示屏接收哪些状态，避免将读卡成功直接视为称重完成。
en: Define the release sequence

Specify the sequence for positioning, identification, weight stability, record storage and exit release. Map each state to the barrier, signal and driver display. Reading a card identifies a transaction; releasing the truck requires a completed weight record.

zh: 改造项目要核对接口
保留现有秤体时，先确认仪表型号、输出协议、线缆走向和控制室位置。与供应方一起验证断网恢复、重复记录处理及人工接管，验收时保留事件日志和对应磅单。
en: Check interfaces on retrofit projects

For an existing scale, identify the indicator model, output protocol, cable routes and control room location. Test network recovery, duplicate handling and manual takeover with the supplier. Retain event logs alongside the matching tickets during acceptance.

zh: 输送带上称量连续料流
皮带秤结合单位带长载荷与带速计算瞬时流量，累计流量可用于统计输送量。询价前记录带宽、速度范围、倾角、物料类型以及可供安装的直线段，并确认现场如何进行零点和实物校验。
en: Continuous conveyor weighing

A belt scale combines belt loading per unit length with belt speed to calculate flow rate and totalize material throughput. Supply belt width, speed range, inclination, material type and available straight run. Identify how the site will check zero and run a material test.

zh: 搬运与铁路车辆称重
叉车称重应核对载荷中心、属具自重和作业时的门架姿态。轨道衡则需确认轨距、车辆类型、轴重以及静态或动态作业要求。这两类应用的安装空间和称重动作差别很大，应分别提供现场尺寸。
en: Forklift and rail applications

For forklift weighing, record load centre, attachment tare and mast position during the weighing step. For rail vehicles, supply track gauge, vehicle type, axle loads and whether weighing takes place at rest or in motion. Give separate layout dimensions for each application.

zh: 反应釜的重量传递路径
釜体、搅拌装置和物料的总重决定支承载荷。管道约束、热膨胀和搅拌振动可能影响读数，应在设计阶段协调管道与称重模块的布置，同时预留清洁、检查和校验空间。
en: Load paths in reactor weighing

The vessel, agitator and contents all contribute to the supported load. Pipe restraint, thermal expansion and agitation can affect the reading. Coordinate pipework and weigh module layouts and leave room for cleaning, inspection and calibration.

zh: 把车辆称重与生产计量分开记录
原料进场与成品出场通常按车次结算，配料过程则按物料和批次计量。规划数据时可通过订单号、物料编码和时间关联两类记录，以便追溯某一批次涉及的收料和发运业务。
en: Connect truck and batch records

Incoming material and dispatched product are typically weighed by truck trip, while batching is recorded by ingredient and batch. Link the two record types using order identifiers, material codes and timestamps so receiving and dispatch activity can be traced to production.

zh: 从现场流程确定设备范围
列出骨料、粉料和液体的进料方式，以及车道、料仓和控制室的位置。明确哪些重量用于库存、配方控制或车辆交接，再逐项核对所需秤体、仪表、接口与异常复核流程。
en: Scope equipment by its role

Map aggregate, powder and liquid feeds alongside truck lanes, bins and the control room. Identify which weights support inventory, recipe control or transfer of goods. For each point, define the scale, indicator, interface and procedure for reviewing exceptions.

zh: 用案例筛选可比的项目
阅读画册案例时，可先对照物料、车辆类型与作业流程。若计划改造现有站点，请提供现用设备清单、典型磅单和希望解决的具体问题，便于讨论哪些设备可沿用、哪些环节需要调整。
en: Compare project references

Compare the materials, vehicle types and operating sequence in the brochure examples with your own site. For a retrofit, provide the installed equipment list, a representative ticket and the specific issue to resolve. These details help establish which assets can be retained and which process steps need to change.
